label: ITR JSON: where each SimplyFile figure goes
aliases: itr json: where each simplyfile figure g
description_nl: Each row: a path in the CBDT JSON and the SimplyFile fact it takes (=text, #number for a fixed value). A list row ('each') writes one item per TDS line, challan or bank account. What is not here stays as the schema's empty default and is completed in the department's utility (balance sheet, P&L, schedules). 2026-10-06: ITR-1 (Sahaj) for My return - an individual's salary, up to two houses, other sources, Chapter VI-A, the tax computation, TDS, challans and refund bank; rows with `each` write a list, skip_zero leaves an optional block out when its figure is nil, seed gives an optional block its required fields first. 2026-10-06: ITR-2 for My return - salary (Schedule S), other sources (Schedule OS), Chapter VI-A, this year's income through CYLA/BFLA (no losses carried), capital gains as totals (111A at 20%, 112/112A at 12.5%), the computation, TDS, challans and refund bank. The capital-gains schedule's scrip-wise rows are completed in the department's utility. 2026-10-06: ITR-4: ITR-1's rows at ITR-4's paths, plus Schedule BP (44ADA / 44AD: nature, receipts by mode, income) and the GSTIN turnover. 2026-10-06: ITR-4 has no OptOutNewTaxRegime (the old regime for business income is Form 10-IEA: F10IEACurrAYOldRegime) and no TotalIntrstPay. 2026-10-06: ITR-2 / ITR-4 PersonalInfo.Status from the client's status (I / H), not always I. 2026-10-06: ITR-2 / ITR-4 verification from the signer (the person, or an HUF's Karta) - 6 rows. 2026-10-06: 80DD, 80DDB, 80EE, 80EEA, 80EEB, 80GG, 80GGC rows and Schedules 80DD, 80EE, 80EEA, 80EEB, 80GGC for ITR-1, ITR-2 and ITR-4. 2026-10-06: Section80DDBUsrType only in the claimed block (UsrDeductUndChapVIA).
